name: Main cable ring lug, 2/4 AWG, 3/8" hole (positive, red jacket)

mounts.note: origin = hole centre on the tongue bottom face (sits directly on the stud boss ring); local +X runs toward the cable; yaw 0 points the cable at +X (battery right end, default for +), 180 at -X (left end, default for -); yaw about Y right-handed
tongue top on the stud axis; the next part in the stack (busbar tab, else nut) sits here

notes: ESTIMATE: typical catalog values for a closed-end heavy-duty tin-plated copper lug, not from a specific datasheet. All dimensions are estimates: tongue width/thickness, overall length, barrel OD, cable OD (with jacket), cable stub length 3 in, barrel length, 4 AWG values. Hole 0.39 in for a 3/8 stud. Barrel bottom is flush with the tongue bottom; barrel is solid (closed shape); the cable stub leaves the far end. Measure the real lug before ordering.
